notes: Soul of Eden je vyvíjena studiem Rayark Inc. (zdrojový popis routiny mylně uváděl jiné studio). Fandom wiki i namu.wiki jsou z tohoto prostředí blokovány Cloudflare ochranou; data pochází z veřejného MediaWiki API Fandom wiki (10 karet s plnými staty), fanouškovského tier-listu LevelWinner (94 karet s frakcí/raritou/abilities, bez staty cost/attack/health) a oficiální galerie soulofeden.com (13 karet pouze se jménem/frakcí). Barvy frakcí jsou odhad autora výzkumu, ve hře nejsou formálně definovány.

factions.name: Gardis Republic
factions.description: One of the four playable factions ("decks") and the first unlocked for new players. Official description: "The Gardis Republic specializes in long-range combat with their different firearms. Paired with air support, this creates a three-dimensional barrage that wipes out any invading enemies." Plays a reactive, control-oriented style with strong damaging spells (e.g. AP Strafing, Nuclear Strike) and unit-removal cards (Sniper, Stealth Blade, Tadakatsu). Guardian is Federation (Guardian Skill "Marine Drop": 3 Soul Power, deploys a drop pod that damages/knocks back enemies and spawns 4 Marine Corps). Shares a card pool ("Gaia") with the Lurkein Aliens.

factions.name: Lurkein Aliens
factions.description: Second faction unlocked (at 300 trophies per community guides). Official description: "The most terrifying traits of the Lurkein are their endless numbers and the multitude of methods they can use to massacre their enemies: Suck their blood dry, weaken their bodies, corrode their prey and devour whatever is left." A proactive, aggressive swarm faction with debuffs but few damage spells. Guardian is X'inn (Guardian Skill "Paralyze": 2 Soul Power, stuns enemies in range for 4s). Shares the "Gaia" card pool with Gardis Republic.

factions.name: Saarn Beasts
factions.description: Third faction unlocked (at 1,000 trophies per community guides). Official description: "The Saarn Beasts rely on their strong bodies for close-range combat. They channel their inner wild instincts to slug it out with their opponents. The healing powers granted by nature help them fight even harder." Swarm/attrition faction with strong unit stats and many healing spells. Guardian is White Horn (Guardian Skill "Life Recovery": 1 Soul Power, cheapest guardian skill, heals allies in range 50 HP/s for 6s). Shares the "Eden" card pool with Veritas Empire.

factions.name: Veritas Empire
factions.description: Fourth and final faction unlocked (at 1,700 trophies per community guides). Official description: "The Veritas Empire has a well-trained army. With perfect coordination and support, their soldiers are extremely effective. On top of that, the protection provided by magic makes their attacks unstoppable." Relies on well-statted units and "Sense"-triggered combat buffs, with tanky AoE cards but limited unit removal. Guardian is Titan (Guardian Skill "Raise the Flag": 2 Soul Power, buffs allies' damage by 60 for 12s). Shares the "Eden" card pool with Saarn Beasts.
